```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America commends the UN Security Council vote of 14-0-1 in favor of Resolution 2334 on December 23, 2016, which condemns all Israeli settlements in the West Bank and East Jerusalem as having “no legal validity” and amounting to a “flagrant violation of international law”.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America wishes that the United States government had voted in favor of Resolution 2334.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America notes that the U.S.’s abstention enabled the first Security Council condemnation of the illegal Israeli occupation of the West Bank since 1980.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America has long viewed the Israeli occupation of the West Bank and its inhumane siege of Gaza as the major barrier to a just settlement of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America commends U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry’s recent speech for highlighting the barriers that continued Israeli settlements pose for justice in the region.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America points out that John Kerry’s speech came too late from an administration that has been consistently unwilling to take meaningful action against Benjamin Netanyahu government’s outrageous settlement policy.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
